summary: Ares Strategic Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 1,932,344 Class I common shares at $26.85 per share (March 31, 2026 NAV), raising $51.9 million under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. The filing also discloses NAV (Class I, S, D: $26.85), aggregate NAV ~$10.5B, debt-to-equity 1.08x, and regular monthly distributions for April–June 2026 at $0.21430 gross per share. This is a routine capital raise and distribution announcement—no special situation event.
